name: player_free_alt_weapon_trail_runtime_states
description: Player::FreeAltWeaponTrailRuntimeStates frees trail runtime storage for alternate weapon-bank controllers 1 through 9 while leaving bank 0 untouched.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player weapon-bank setup source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x438b60 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState*, loading playerState, iterating nine alternate weapon banks starting at bank 1, probing each controller A and B trailRuntimeState pointer, and calling OptCatalog::FreeTrailRuntimeStateStorage for non-null entries without clearing the stored pointer.
The native smoke verifies bank 0 trail pointers are skipped and representative bank 1, bank 4, and bank 9 trail-runtime allocations are accepted by the free path.
